Schlankes Apple AirTag Etui

https://makerworld.com/de/models/643237-slim-apple-airtag-case#profileId-569241

This 3D model is specifically designed to reduce the thickness of the classic Apple AirTag from 8 mm to 6.6 mm, making it easier to fit in your wallet or other tight spaces. The AirTag will sit more comfortably and be less obtrusive while maintaining full functionality.

Key Features:

* Thickness reduced from 8 mm to 6.6 mm.
* Ideal solution for wallets and slim spaces.
* Designed for 3D printing, easily printable on any standard 3D printer.
* Modern and minimalist design.
* Keeps the AirTag securely in place without damage.
Technical Specifications:

* Dimensions: modified for Apple AirTag (6.6 mm)
* Printable file in 3MF format ready for immediate use
* Recommended print layer height: 0.2 mm
* Compatible with common filament types: PLA, PETG, ASA, ABS

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#060101)
